heading: FAQ — Why use Dispensed?
text:
Q: Why use Dispensed?
A: Dispensed is an online telehealth platform that connects Australians with doctors through secure, convenient virtual consultations. All consultations are conducted by Australian-registered clinicians in line with medical and data protection standards. Our service has transparent pricing, no lock-in contracts, and no hidden fees.

heading: FAQ — Who can use Dispensed?
text:
Q: Who can use Dispensed?
A: Anyone in Australia who would like to learn more about healthcare pathways can use Dispensed. Whether you are exploring your options or ready to consult, we provide resources and clinician access regardless of where you are on your journey. However, our services are not for everyone and our clinicians will determine whether our services may be suitable for you.

heading: FAQ — What makes Dispensed different from other providers?
text:
Q: What makes Dispensed different from other providers?
A: Dispensed is a fully online healthcare platform designed to connect patients with Australian-registered clinicians through secure telehealth consultations. The service focuses on convenience, transparency, and confidentiality while maintaining compliance with Australian medical and data protection requirements.

heading: FAQ — How does the telehealth appointment work?
text:
Q: How does the telehealth appointment work?
A: You can book a phone consultation online at a time that suits you. Consultations are conducted securely by licensed professional health care providers. After your consultation you will receive clear guidance on next steps.

heading: FAQ — Is my personal data protected?
text:
Q: Is my personal data protected?
A: Yes. We use secure systems to manage and store your information in line with Australian data protection regulations. Your private health details remain confidential and safe.

heading: FAQ — Are healthcare providers regulated?
text:
Q: Are healthcare providers regulated?
A: Yes. All clinicians who work with the Dispensed platform are registered and regulated by the appropriate professional bodies in Australia. We verify their credentials.

heading: FAQ — How long does a healthcare plan last?
text:
Q: How long does a healthcare plan last?
A: Healthcare plans are flexible and continue for as long as you choose. Clinicians review your plan monthly and you can cancel at any time without fees.

heading: FAQ — How much does it cost to get started?
text:
Q: How much does it cost to get started?
A: There is no charge to register or complete the initial questionnaire with Dispensed. The first consultation is free, and there are no onboarding fees or lock-in contracts. You will only be charged for services if the clinician recommends them and you choose to proceed. Pricing information is available here.

heading: FAQ — How much does alternative healthcare cost?
text:
Q: How much does alternative healthcare cost?
A: Healthcare plan pricing varies depending on individual needs. Plans start from $99 per month.

heading: FAQ — What is included in the healthcare plan?
text:
Q: What is included in the healthcare plan?
A: Each Dispensed healthcare plan is designed to make ongoing care simple. It includes secure telehealth consultations with Australian-registered clinicians, ongoing reviews, and administrative support to help manage appointments and next steps.‍Express delivery is also included to ensure prompt and discreet arrival. Our support team is available seven days a week via Live Chat to assist with general enquiries and help you stay on track with your care. All of these services are included in a single monthly payment, providing a straightforward and reliable way to manage your care through Dispensed. If a clinician issues a prescription, dispensing and delivery are managed securely in accordance with privacy and regulatory requirements.‍

heading: FAQ — What is the cancellation policy?
text:
Q: What is the cancellation policy?
A: Dispensed offers a flexible cancellation policy with no lock-in contracts or cancellation fees. You can pause or cancel your monthly plan at any time if you no longer wish to continue. This applies to all ongoing healthcare plans managed through the platform. There are no hidden costs or long-term commitments.

heading: FAQ — How do I book an appointment?
text:
Q: How do I book an appointment?
A: You can book a telehealth appointment online in just a few minutes. Start by completing a short pre-screening questionnaire here. If a consultation is suitable, you’ll be able to select a preferred time to meet with one of our Australian-registered clinicians by phone or video. Appointments are conducted securely and privately, with no need to visit a clinic in person.

heading: FAQ — Do I need a referral to use Dispensed?
text:
Q: Do I need a referral to use Dispensed?
A: No referral is required. You can complete a short online questionnaire and, if suitable, book a telehealth consultation directly with one of our doctors.

heading: FAQ — Who is alternative healthcare treatment suitable for?
text:
Q: Who is alternative healthcare treatment suitable for?
A: Whether or not certain healthcare services may be suitable will depend on several things, including your medical history, age, and other factors. Completing the pre-screening questionnaire helps us determine whether you can proceed to a consultation with a clinician for further assessment.

heading: FAQ — Can I get a same-day consultation?
text:
Q: Can I get a same-day consultation?
A: In some cases, same-day consultations may be available depending on clinician availability. You can view and select from the available appointment times through the booking system.

heading: FAQ — Can I get ongoing support after the consultation?
text:
Q: Can I get ongoing support after the consultation?
A: Yes. After your consultation, our team can help with follow-up appointments, general questions, or ongoing administrative support as needed.

heading: FAQ — How does delivery work and is it discreet?
text:
Q: How does delivery work and is it discreet?
A: Dispensed can arrange for Australia-wide delivery through secure and confidential channels. All orders are sent in plain packaging with no identifying details visible. Once your order is confirmed, you’ll receive a tracking link so you can follow its progress. Delivery times typically range from 2 to 5 business days, depending on your location.‍*A flat $9.95 shipping fee applies to all treatment plans below $129.‍

heading: FAQ — Can I switch from another clinic to Dispensed?
text:
Q: Can I switch from another clinic to Dispensed?
A: Yes - you can move your care to Dispensed if you’re currently with another provider. Below is a general overview of how the transfer process works:‍Complete the registration process.If a consultation is suitable, book a telehealth appointment with one of our clinicians.During the consultation, your clinician can review your existing healthcare plan and medical history.As part of the transfer process, a discharge summary will be requested from your previous clinic to help ensure continuity of service and keep your records up to date.Once your information has been reviewed, your new clinician will continue coordinating your care through Dispensed.This process helps maintain a smooth transition and ensures your care remains consistent.

heading: Hey there, Dispensed Community!
text:
Okay, we want to chat about keeping our community respectful, friendly and just downright awesome here at Dispensed. We get it, sometimes things don’t go as planned and that can lead to disappointment. But don’t be down, we're all about finding solutions and making our service even better than before.
Now we've set some Community Guidelines and we're counting on everyone in the Dispensed ecosystem, whether you're part of our stellar team, a patient, a potential future patient or even our suppliers to be on board and follow the guidelines:
Respectful Behaviour: We're big fans of our patients opening up, being honest with us and letting us know both what we’re doing great and what we might be able to improve on. But let’s keep it friendly! No insults, personal attacks, abusive or aggressive behaviour of any kind will be tolerated. Show respect to everyone in the Dispensed community, no matter who you are communicating with.
Anti-Bullying & Harassment: We do not have time to humour trolls! Let's keep this community free from any bullying, teasing or any form of intimidation tactic. We're all here to help each other and cultivate a positive community.
Thoughtful Communication & No Spam: We love a good chat and we’re always here to help — but let’s keep communication balanced and respectful. Repeated or excessive messaging across chat, email or phone that disrupts our ability to assist other patients isn’t okay. Please don’t spam or repeatedly contact our team about the same issue once it’s being handled. We promise we’ll get back to you as soon as we can.
Embracing Diversity: We are inclusive and invite people from all walks of life to join our community! Let's respect each other's quirks and differences. None of that racism, sexism, or any other "ism" business, it has no place here.
Ethical Conduct: Laws and rules are there for a reason. Fraudulent behaviour such as impersonation, defamatory actions, false information or documentation are all types of conduct which are strictly prohibited by Dispensed. That means no funny business as in no fraud, no spreading rumours and no sharing anything that's not PG. Let's keep this space, honest and factual.
Now, if someone breaks these Community Guidelines, unfortunately we won't hesitate to remove them from our platform indefinitely.
Thanks for being part of the Dispensed community and helping us keep the space positive, welcoming and inclusive.

text:
Q: What’s the best way to take my medical cannabis?
A: Follow your doctor’s instructions carefully. Oils are for oral use only, can be taken by holding under the tongue before swallowing or swallowed straight away, while dried flower is prescribed for vaporisation only - never smoked.

heading: FAQ — How do I find my ideal dose?
text:
Q: How do I find my ideal dose?
A: It’s called titration: usually over a 10 day period. Your doctor will guide you and give you a maximum daily dose. Contact the clinic if you have any questions or concerns.‍

text:

text:

A: Use a medical-grade device only. Keep it clean to prevent bacteria build-up. Never inhale using homemade or non-certified tools.

text:

heading: FAQ — What can medical cannabis treat in the UK?
text:
Q: What can medical cannabis treat in the UK?
A: Medical cannabis may be prescribed for a range of conditions including chronic pain, anxiety, PTSD, insomnia, digestive and neurological disorders, sleep disturbances, supportive cancer care, certain types of epilepsy, and more. However, it’s typically considered only after other conventional treatments have been tried without success.

heading: FAQ — Will it cure my illness?
text:
Q: Will it cure my illness?
A: No. It may help manage symptoms but it’s not a cure.‍

heading: FAQ — Why didn’t my GP mention this?
text:
Q: Why didn’t my GP mention this?
A: Medical cannabis is still emerging in the UK, and NHS prescriptions remain extremely limited. Currently, the NHS does not fund Medical Cannabis treatments. For access, many patients turn to private clinics, which offer more treatment options.

heading: FAQ — How do I know if it will work for me?
text:
Q: How do I know if it will work for me?
A: Everyone responds differently. Some feel major relief; others see little change. That’s why careful monitoring is key. Careful titration to your optimal dose and monitoring your symptom control is key.

heading: FAQ — Do I need to have tried other treatments first?
text:
Q: Do I need to have tried other treatments first?
A: Yes – you must show that conventional treatments haven’t worked for you, such as two or more medications prescribed by your doctor or interventions like physiotherapy or talking therapies recommended by your doctor.

heading: Hey there, Dispensed Community!
text:
Okay, we want to chat about keeping our community respectful, friendly and just downright awesome here at Dispensed. We get it, sometimes things don’t go as planned and that can lead to disappointment. But don’t be down, we're all about finding solutions and making our service even better than before.
Now we've set some Community Guidelines and we're counting on everyone in the Dispensed ecosystem, whether you're part of our stellar team, a patient, a potential future patient or even our suppliers to be on board and follow the guidelines:
Respectful Behaviour: We're big fans of our patients opening up, being honest with us and letting us know both what we’re doing great and what we might be able to improve on. But let’s keep it friendly! No insults, personal attacks, abusive or aggressive behaviour of any kind will be tolerated. Show respect to everyone in the Dispensed community, no matter who you are communicating with.
Anti-Bullying & Harassment: We do not have time to humour trolls! Let's keep this community free from any bullying, teasing or any form of intimidation tactic. We're all here to help each other and cultivate a positive community.
Thoughtful Communication & No Spam: We love a good chat and we’re always here to help — but let’s keep communication balanced and respectful. Repeated or excessive messaging across chat, email or phone that disrupts our ability to assist other patients isn’t okay. Please don’t spam or repeatedly contact our team about the same issue once it’s being handled. We promise we’ll get back to you as soon as we can.
Embracing Diversity: We are inclusive and invite people from all walks of life to join our community! Let's respect each other's quirks and differences. None of that racism, sexism, or any other "ism" business, it has no place here.
Ethical Conduct: Laws and rules are there for a reason. Fraudulent behaviour such as impersonation, defamatory actions, false information or documentation are all types of conduct which are strictly prohibited by Dispensed. That means no funny business as in no fraud, no spreading rumours and no sharing anything that's not PG. Let's keep this space, honest and factual.
Now, if someone breaks these Community Guidelines, unfortunately we won't hesitate to remove them from our platform indefinitely.
Thanks for being part of the Dispensed community and helping us keep the space positive, welcoming and inclusive.
